ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 80% low-intensity (dark) to 20% high-intensity (light) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity base with significant high-intensity white mottling and splatter patterns localized on the left lobe tip and scattered discrete white spotting across the medial and right lobe areas.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped notch with an estimated angle of 115-125 degrees at the central convergence of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular, high-frequency serrations with pixel-amplitude variations along the entire trailing edge boundary, with more pronounced jagged peaks on the distal sections.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a slight concave sweep starting from the notch, transitioning to a convex curve towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular high-contrast pixel clusters (rosettes) localized on the distal left lobe and scattered across the central fluke region, consistent with barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, non-parallel white linear marks (rake marks) observed primarily on the right lobe and central fluke area, oriented diagonally across the primary pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive surface scarring including both circular attachment marks and linear rake marks across both fluke lobes; notable irregular trailing edge topography.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced white pigmentation zone on the leading/outer edge of the left fluke tip, appearing as a high-contrast 'splatter' pattern.
